article.name: Get Started for Free on 10Web
article.title: Get Started for Free on 10Web
article.body:
Starting for free on 10Web gives you access to powerful tools like the AI Website Builder, Automated WordPress Hosting, Website Booster, and User Management. Use them to easily create, optimize, and manage websites all in one platform.

How to get started for free

  1. Go to 10Web.io and select Get started for Free.
  2. Click on Create a new website with AI.

Create a new website with AI

Choose whether you’d like to create an informational website or a website with an online store, then click Next.

For an online store website

  1. Choose the business type that best matches your company, then click Next.
  2. Select the language for your store, enter your company name and a brief description.
  3. Indicate whether you already own a domain or would like to purchase one through 10Web’s Domain Registrar. If registering a new domain, simply specify your preferred domain name, then click Next.
  4. The AI Generator will suggest three products and categories based on your description. Modify these as needed to match your offerings.
  5. The AI will also suggest your business’s three main services or features, which can be adjusted manually if needed.
  6. Select your website’s Theme and Structure and click Generate.

    Note:

    For some business types, you may skip theme selection and go directly to the next step.

  7. Create an account by entering your personal details or signing up with Google, then click Sign up to initiate the website creation process.
  8. Once the website generation is completed, you’ll see a success notification. Click Preview and edit to view your new website.
    • Check both Desktop and Mobile views for your website’s responsiveness.
    • If you’re unsatisfied with the initial design, you can Regenerate the website or make quick customizations to fonts and colors.
  9. To unlock full editing capabilities, start a 7-day free trial of the Pro version by attaching your credit card.

    Note:

    Your card will not be charged during the trial unless you perform restricted actions (e.g., disabling site lock), which may trigger charges. You can cancel the trial anytime within the 7 days to avoid charges.

For an informational website

  1. Choose a business type and click Next.
  2. Enter your company name and a brief description.
  3. Indicate whether you have an existing domain or would like to register one through 10Web’s Domain Registrar.
  4. The AI will automatically generate a customized website structure. You can adjust this by:
    • Customizing each page section-by-section.
    • Adding additional sections or detailed prompts.
    • Including key pages specific to your business.
  5. Adjust the style of your website by selecting fonts, colors, and general aesthetic options to craft your ideal look.
  6. Before generating the website, create an account by entering personal details or signing up with Google, then click Sign up to begin the website creation process.
  7. Once generation completes, a success message will appear. Click Preview and edit to view the website.
  8. Check both Desktop and Mobile views. You also have the option to Regenerate the website or make quick adjustments to fonts and colors.
    To make detailed edits, activate a 7-day free trial of the Pro version by adding your credit card information.

    Note:

    Your card will not be charged during the trial unless you disable site lock or perform other restricted actions. You may cancel the trial within 7 days to prevent charges.

Convert a non-WordPress site to WordPress with AI

  1. Create an account using your details or sign in with Google.
  2. Once signed in to my.10web.io, click on Proceed in the "Convert a non-WordPress site to WordPress with AI" section.
  3. Enter the URL of each page you want to convert. These pages will become part of your new WordPress website and will be ready for AI Builder editing.

Migrate to WordPress site to 10Web hosting

If you have your own WordPress website you can migrate it to 10web hosting by choosing the option. Automatic migration will make a copy of your website on 10Web hosting without affecting your live website.

For more details: How to automatically migrate your website to 10Web.

The 7-day free trial

The free trial period offers access to all 10Web Pro features. You can cancel anytime during the trial without incurring charges.

Important:

SSH and SFTP credentials are not available on free plans, and attempting to enable these may result in charges.

AI Website Builder

With 10Web AI Builder, you can easily create or recreate websites by:

  • Generating a brand-new page based on responses to a few business-related questions.
  • Using the AI Recreation Tool to recreate unlimited existing web pages.

    Note:

    Free platform users are limited to generating one website, and full editing requires enabling the 7-day free trial.

10Web Builder

10Web Builder (based on Elementor) provides extensive website editing capabilities, enhanced by over 80 widgets for added functionality and customization. During the 7-day free trial, additional features include:

  • AI Page Generation (available in 10Web Dashboard > AI Builder > Add Page)
  • Section Generation within the builder, where you can add sections by describing your design needs.

10Web Booster

10Web Website Booster enhances frontend and backend performance, applying over 35 optimization techniques. These include image compression and are powered by Google Cloud for improved speed and stability.

Hosting on 10Web

10Web’s Managed WordPress Hosting (powered by Google) includes automated backups, SEO tools, and robust hosting. All websites generated or recreated are hosted directly on the 10Web platform.

User and team management

User and Team Management allows you to collaborate by creating workspaces and assigning different access levels to team members, ensuring efficient project completion.
